1. Updated the function definition in `app/pricing.py` from `calc(items)` to `compute_total(items)`
2. Updated all import statements and usages in `app/report.py` to reference `compute_total` instead of `calc`
3. Updated all import statements and usages in `app/cli.py` to reference `compute_total` instead of `calc`
4. Verified that `python3 test_app.py` still outputs "9.0" followed by "total=9.0", confirming the functionality remains intact

I also confirmed through searching that there are no remaining references to the old function name "calc" anywhere in the codebase, ensuring a complete transition to the new naming convention.
